description: Menu-bar / system-tray controller for the ttrff cosmetic animation-speed mods for Toontown Rewritten (owner's own client; cosmetic-only). Windows and macOS: auto-attach, per-group toggles, and a timed auto-collect for Cartoonival bags.
notes: Personal cosmetic-only tool for the owner's own Toontown Rewritten client. Do not distribute further. First run creates a private venv (pystray/pillow/psutil/frida) inside the app dir and seeds the editable mod table to %LOCALAPPDATA%\ttrff\modset.json. Requires python on PATH (e.g. scoop install python).
